description: Pre-configured macros for benchmarking LLM responses across different task types

data.name: LLM Benchmark Tests
data.description: Standard prompts for testing and comparing LLM capabilities
data.f1_macro: Explain the following concept in simple terms that a 10-year-old could understand: [concept]
data.f2_macro: Translate the following text to French, then Spanish, then Japanese: [text]
data.f3_macro: Write a Python function that [task]. Include docstrings and type hints.
data.f4_macro: Analyze the following argument for logical fallacies: [argument]
data.f5_macro: Summarize the key points from the following text in 3 bullet points: [text]
